items.headline: Coastal Flood Advisory issued November 27 at 5:09PM AKST until November 28 at 6:00AM AKST by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Coastal Flooding with water levels 1.5 to 3.0 feet
above the highest tide line possible.

* WHERE...Kipnuk, Kongiganak, and Kwigillingok.

* WHEN...UNTIL 6 AM Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Potential flooding of low lying areas, including
lowest portions of boardwalks. Coastal erosion possible.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...A long duration of onshore winds combined
with higher-than-normal tides will increase the potential for
elevated water levels, high surf, and coastal erosion tonight.

items.headline: High Surf Advisory issued November 27 at 3:17PM AKST until November 27 at 8:00PM AKST by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Breaking waves of 2 to 4 feet. West-southwest winds 15
to 20 mph gusting to 25 to 30 mph.

* WHERE...Homer Spit.

* WHEN...Until 8 PM this evening.

* IMPACTS...Water and light debris could wash over portions of
the Homer Spit Road. Minor beach erosion is possible.
items.instruction:
Precautions should be taken to protect property, such as securing
or moving property away from the shoreline.

items.headline: Wind Advisory issued November 27 at 2:54PM AKST until November 27 at 10:00PM AKST by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...South winds 20 to 30 mph with gusts up to 55 mph.

* WHERE...Eastern Alaska Range North of Trims Camp.

* WHEN...Until 10 PM AKST this evening.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects.
items.areas: Eastern Alaska Range North of Trims Camp
items.instruction:
Winds this strong can make driving difficult, especially for high
profile vehicles. Use extra caution.

items.headline: Winter Storm Warning issued November 27 at 12:01PM AKST until November 27 at 10:00PM AKST by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Periods of blizzard conditions. Winds gusting as high as 45
mph.

* WHERE...Point Thomson.

* WHEN...Until 10 PM AKST this evening.

* IMPACTS...Areas of blowing snow could significantly reduce
visibility.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Strong winds will blow snow already on the
ground to create areas of low visibility near the surface. No
significant visibility reductions are expected at Barter
Island/Kaktovik due to open water limiting the availability of
blowable snow to the east.
items.instruction:
If you must travel, keep an extra flashlight, food, and water in your
vehicle in case of an emergency.
